measurement: Connected-component centroids of the exact-white 1x1 eyes and 2x2 mouth, matched to supplied skin outer-front texel regions. Fit orthographic affine texel basis, then solve slope=sin(pitch)*tan(abs(yaw)), vertical_ratio=cos(pitch)/cos(yaw). Raster quantization means fitted angles are estimates; exact constants corroborated in unchanged NMSR source.

visible_faces.screen_right: front: base UV [8,8,8,8], outer UV [40,8,8,8]; glasses/eyes/mouth
visible_faces.screen_left: player-right side: base UV [0,8,8,8], outer UV [32,8,8,8]

blender_conversion: Original camera azimuth +45 around +Z measured atan2(x,-y); rotate head +90 about +Z, giving relative camera azimuth -45. Equivalent to NMSR +45 under its opposite yaw convention. Camera elevation remains atan(1/sqrt(2)); roll zero.
